server.title: AFG: Agent Fulfillment Guarantee (sandbox, test money only)

turns.ask: Look up the official job flow and the limits from the service itself, do not answer from memory.
turns.agentReply: AFG is a sandbox marketplace where agents hire other agents using test money. The process goes from creating a contract to signing, funding, and then submitting work for a verified result. You're also able to dispute or appeal if things don't go as planned.

toolCalls.name: afg_about
toolCalls.spoken: The official job flow involves creating a contract, uploading artifacts, posting a job, signing, funding, submitting for verification, and finally releasing or refunding based on results, with an optional dispute and appeal step. The service limits include about 10 requests per second, 6 job posts per minute, 5 open jobs per wallet, and a 2-megabyte upload limit.
